meta.title: B2B & Partners: Moving, Clearance, Renovation Munich
meta.description: Referral commission for partners, volume pricing for corporate clients. Property manager craft services Munich — priority scheduling, dedicated contact.

hero.headline: Two ways to work with us: referral partners and corporate clients
hero.subheadline: Whether you refer clients to us or need recurring services yourself, we offer fixed terms, priority scheduling and one dedicated contact person.

referral.headline: Real-estate agents, relocation services, property managers
referral.body: Have clients who need a move, a clearance or a renovation? Refer them to us — we take care of the rest.

benefits.title: Commission
benefits.body: You receive a referral commission for every completed job you bring us.

benefits.title: Priority scheduling
benefits.body: Requests from partners are scheduled with priority.

benefits.title: Dedicated contact
benefits.body: One fixed contact person at our end, not rotating staff.

benefits.title: Simple handoff
benefits.body: You send the lead, we handle consultation, quote and delivery.

corporate.headline: Companies with recurring needs
corporate.body: Property managers, real-estate companies and businesses with regular moving, clearance or renovation needs benefit from fixed partner terms.

benefits.title: Partner pricing
benefits.body: Fixed, discounted rates for recurring work instead of one-off quotes.

benefits.title: Priority scheduling
benefits.body: Your jobs are scheduled with priority.

benefits.title: Dedicated contact
benefits.body: One contact across all three brands — moving, clearance, renovation.

benefits.title: One contract, three trades
benefits.body: No need to coordinate separate providers.

form.headline: Become a partner
form.body: Tell us a bit about yourself — we'll get back to you with the right terms.
